subject.title: fix: keep tail alive and replay timed-out messages

question: Is the focused regression suite on b7a03ca sufficient for this message-delivery change, or should merge wait for a controlled live Discord handler-timeout and replay transcript?
rationale: The patch is internally coherent and heavily tested, but it changes when a live archive process stays running and how a missed message is durably recovered, which synthetic tests cannot fully establish against Discord behavior.

options.title: Require one live fault run
options.body: Capture a redacted controlled timeout showing the tail remains active and the exact missed message is later recovered without duplicate events or cursor rollback.

options.title: Accept focused suite
options.body: Treat the race-tested regression coverage and member-authored implementation as sufficient once all required checks complete.

recommendation.title: Require one live fault run
recommendation.body: Capture a redacted controlled timeout showing the tail remains active and the exact missed message is later recovered without duplicate events or cursor rollback.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest observed history in the affected Discord sync and cursor paths and is a repository member associated with the final design.
